title: Kwii.aang and Da.axiigang, spruce-root hat
authors: National Museum of the American Indian
lineage: Brief research notes paraphrase inspected passages; not a source copy.

passages.note: The Smithsonian dates the Haida hat to approximately 1900, attributes its weaving to Kwii.aang (Isabella Edenshaw) and painting to Da.axiigang (Charles Edenshaw), and presents family testimony on weaving. This one object does not date the origin of the wider craft.
